d: An unwanted animal guest can turn an ordinary day into complete chaos! This compilation follows Ernie Brown Jr., better known as Turtleman, as he responds to some particularly troublesome wildlife calls. From a wild mink raiding a feed store to a family of raccoons taking over the space beneath a porch, these encounters call for quick thinking and unconventional wildlife-rescue skills. A basement overrun with snakes brings another challenge, while a stubborn skunk makes an already tricky animal rescue mission even more unpredictable.
